mentions.name: Zion Williamson
mentions.analysis: Zion Williamson has been complaining of soreness since about game two and now has strained his hamstring. He is expected to be out for a minimum of three weeks, possibly longer, due to repeated mismanagement of his hamstring injuries.

mentions.name: Trey Murphy III
mentions.analysis: Trey Murphy is returning from a long-term injury and is expected to play significant minutes with Zion Williamson out.

mentions.name: BJ Boston
mentions.analysis: With multiple injuries on the Pelicans, BJ Boston is expected to get a lot of shots and play a lot of minutes.

mentions.name: Jose Alvarado
mentions.analysis: Jose Alvarado is a must-roster player with the current injuries on the Pelicans, including Zion Williamson and CJ McCollum.

mentions.name: Jeremiah Robinson-Earl
mentions.analysis: Jeremiah Robinson-Earl might start depending on how the Pelicans decide to use Trey Murphy and Brandon Ingram.

mentions.name: Aaron Gordon
mentions.analysis: Aaron Gordon is expected to be out for multiple weeks, making him a drop candidate in fantasy leagues.

mentions.name: Payton Watson
mentions.analysis: With Aaron Gordon out, Payton Watson is a potential add, although Denver's schedule is not favorable this week.

mentions.name: Andrew Nembhard
mentions.analysis: Indiana has no games on low volume days, making Andrew Nembhard less valuable for streaming this week.

mentions.name: Obi Toppin
mentions.analysis: Indiana has no games on low volume days, making Obi Toppin less valuable for streaming this week.

mentions.name: Jalen Duren
mentions.analysis: Jalen Duren missed the last game with an ankle sprain. It's not expected to be serious, but he might miss a game or two.

mentions.name: Zach LaVine
mentions.analysis: Zach LaVine has missed a few games with a groin problem. There's an 80% chance he will be available for week four.

mentions.name: Jimmy Butler
mentions.analysis: Jimmy Butler rolled his ankle and his availability for week four is uncertain.

mentions.name: Keegan Murray
mentions.analysis: Sacramento has a favorable schedule with five games in seven nights, making Keegan Murray a valuable pick-up.

mentions.name: Kevin Huerter
mentions.analysis: Sacramento has a favorable schedule with five games in seven nights, making Kevin Huerter a valuable pick-up.

mentions.name: Khris Middleton
mentions.analysis: Khris Middleton is not expected to return soon due to ongoing injury issues, making him a drop candidate.
